ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What part of the plant does the diagram depict?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram contains many schematic diagrams of flat plant structures, with clearly visible midribs, branching veins, leaves of different shapes, leaf margin forms, and some arrangements or variants of leaves. On the right side and below, there are also examples of different margins, lobes, and leaf shapes. Reasoning: These structures all conform to the characteristics of plant leaves, rather than roots, stems, flowers, or fruits. Therefore, this diagram depicts plant leaves.
